summary: P0 + P1 testing complete. Backend (7/7 passing in /app/backend/tests/test_bid_cap_and_vip.py): (1) Bid cap fix VERIFIED — POST /api/agent/auctions/{id}/bid rejects bid_fee_percent >= client fee_percent with HTTP 400 ('strictement inférieure'); tested rejection at 3.0% and at exactly 2.0% (equal); 1.5% accepted. (2) Source code review of run_auction (/app/backend/routers/transfers.py:323-337) confirms simulated bids cannot exceed client_fee_pct (random.uniform upper bound is client_fee_pct - 0.05, and explicit cap-clamp at line 334). (3) TransferDraftIn now accepts vip_fee_amount + vip_express. Totals verified: 100€+2%+VIP15€=117€, 100€+2%+VIP+20€=122€, 1000€+2%+VIP+20€=1040€, back-compat (no vip_fee_amount field) returns total=102€. (4) Confirm flow works with new total (66€ for 50€ + 1€ fee + 15€ VIP). Frontend (manual via Playwright at 390x844): (1) Login screen background = #022a6b navy blue VERIFIED. (2) Onboarding step2/step3 texts match spec ('Choisissez librement le mode de remise...', 'Code PIN à 6 chiffres, biométrie, KYC vérifié, chiffrement AES-256, traçabilité, conformité AML/RGPD.'); images prefetch confirmed at code level. (3) Transfer Step 1: 3 service cards HORIZONTAL (flexDirection:row, gap:8), testIDs service-standard / service-vip / service-vip-express present, labels '1-4h' '1%, min. 15€' and '1-2h' '1,5%, min. 20€' match exactly. (4) Transfer Step 2: no chips 1%/2%/3%/4%/5% present, custom input testID='fee-custom' with '%' badge; typing 2.5 displays 'Frais à payer: 2.50 EUR'; typing 15+blur clamps to 10; typing 0.1+blur snaps to 0.5. (5) Transfer Step 3: 2 separate boxes 'DÉTAIL DU TRANSFERT' (Montant 100.00 EUR, Frais transfert (2%) 2.00 EUR, Service VIP (1%, min 15€) 15.00 EUR, Total à débiter 117.00 EUR) + 'INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES' (Taux, Mode, Motif). 'Connaissez-vous bien cette personne ?' box is white. 'Valider et payer' button present. All P0/P1 requirements pass.
